BEHIND THE EXPERIMENT

Real hydraulics.
Transparent limitations.

Every supported leak, demand, and opening combination is simulated ahead of time using EPANET on the original two-zone network. The browser replays those steady-state results and adds seeded sensor noise.

A new Random Forest reads six pressure residuals. It is trained on separate simulated operating conditions; it never receives the selected leak location as an input.

Observation steps are a replay sequence, not a transient hydraulic simulation or elapsed physical seconds. The baseline assumes the current demand is known. Results do not establish performance on real water networks.
